semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact identity, mana cost, types, starting loyalty and ordered minus-three definition.
Zero cost, two black and green 2/2 Wolf tokens and their captured Garruk-subtype death instruction.
Minus-six cost and the exact controller-scoped plus-three and trample emblem effects.
Actual activation destroys either player's legal creature and then draws.
A legal indestructible creature survives and the draw still happens.
Noncreature targeting fails and a sole stale target prevents the entire ability from resolving.
The captured minus-three continues after its source changes zones.
Actual zero activation creates two exact Wolves with public token identities.
A ceased Wolf retains its captured trigger and public stack presentation; current controlled Garruk subtypes receive counters.
Actual simultaneous Wolf deaths create two separately resolving triggers.
The zero-cost loyalty activation uses the normal per-turn allowance.
Actual Act of Treason and Bolt make the Wolf's controller at death own its trigger.
An actual Cackling Counterpart copy dies and its captured trigger survives token cessation.
A labeled synthetic ability-removal effect suppresses the actual Wolf's death trigger.
Actual Swords to Plowshares exiles the Wolf without a death trigger.
Labeled synthetic changes before resolution establish live controller, planeswalker and Garruk subtype selection.
Synthetic lethal and zero-loyalty marks cause real simultaneous state-based actions before the Wolf trigger.
A surviving foreign-owned recipient retains the accepted Lae'zel replacement when the trigger controller leaves.
A real Banishing Light observer suspends and restores the begun counter event exactly once.
A departed recipient is removed and the empty begun batch completes without a stranded choice.
A labeled synthetic same-ID generation change is pruned while another original recipient completes.
The actual ultimate creates a public emblem after Garruk dies and affects current and later controlled creatures.
Labeled synthetic control, type and newer ability-removal effects exercise the live emblem scope.
Two separately created emblems stack plus-three modifiers while trample remains present.
The emblem and its marker-linked effects leave with their controller; a borrowed creature survives.
The newer emblem grants trample after an older synthetic ability-removal effect.
Actual combat assigns lethal damage to a blocker and excess trample damage to the defending player.
The engine's server-only hand facts contain the drawn card without publishing its identity in a move or log.
All three actual abilities, Wolf death and subsequent action replay deterministically from accepted encoded commands.
